title: Dealer client position file (Finspot OMS, Dealer Client position)
purpose: Each client's open derivatives positions at the previous business day's close, under the dealer that handles them, product NRML: one line per client and contract, a long position as buy quantity and amount, a short one as sell quantity and amount. The amount is quantity × Ledgerline's average price of the open side (the column says amount; Finspot's sample value could also be read as a price, so confirm with Finspot). The dealer is the firm's default position dealer in Connections → Finspot uploads. Exchange: NFO, BFO, CDS, BCD, MCX, NCX; instrument OPTIDX, OPTSTK, FUTIDX, FUTSTK (FUTCUR, OPTCUR for currency; FUTCOM, OPTFUT for commodities); for futures the strike is 0 and the option type XX.
linked: Front office → Finspot uploads (dealer client positions)
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Dealer Client position (13 columns, title line 'Dealer-Client Position Information')
